title: Store selectors across all no-selector subscriptions
change: Convert every no-selector store call to a selector, using useShallow for object selections. Add the no-restricted-syntax lint rule from the audit. Re-baseline the ratchet.
exit: cd frontend && pnpm run lint  →  exit 0
cd frontend && pnpm run test:ci  →  exit 0
forbidden: Do NOT restructure any component. Selector conversion only — no JSX changes, no extracted subcomponents, no renamed props.
escalate: A component needs the whole store legitimately. Name it and justify; do not add a blanket eslint-disable.
